portInfo.description: Nagasaki Port is a mountain-ringed natural harbour opened in 1571 with a long foreign-trade history visible in streets and food culture. Cruise ships pass under the Venus-Wing Bridge to a central terminal with Japan’s largest-class CIQ facilities and free Wi-Fi; a UNESCO World Heritage site is within walking distance and major districts are reachable by streetcar. Bus tours commonly include Huis Ten Bosch, onsen and Shimabara Castle. Berth length/depth were not published on the captured MLIT guide page.
